cohort: A 36-year-old woman who underwent a cesarean section 8 years prior to presenting with an acute, painful abdominal wall mass.
finding: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman who presented with an acute, painful abdominal wall mass 8 years post-cesarean section, which was ultimately diagnosed and surgically treated as scar endometriosis.
mod_finding: The case highlights that postcesarean scar endometriosis can present as an acute, painful abdominal wall mass years after a cesarean section delivery, making diagnosis challenging.
